analysis:
Both units are head-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md, a documentation-only file. The patch excerpt shows the v0.10.10 candidate header plus new rollout notes about 'darkbloom waitlist' and account approval gating for new sandbox/cluster setups. The remaining visible lines (1606-2145) are unchanged surrounding release history and no hunk coordinates cover them. No executable code, protocol, crypto, key-handling or configuration changed in the supplied evidence, so no regression against the threat model is identified.

Threat-model relevance (documentation claims only):
- T-041 and the encrypted SSD prefix cache: the changelog describes quantized SSD prefix records at balanced precision, namespace binding to binary and metallib hashes, TTL and eviction behaviour. These are prose from earlier release sections; this PR does not alter them. The actual implementation under provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/KVCacheSSD/ was not supplied, so claims such as the HMAC-only names, the 30-minute TTL and per-binary namespaces are unverified here.
- TB-012/T-059/T-060 and TB-013/T-061: the notes on add-on holds and the sandbox installer download describe existing behaviour. The new waitlist gating is a coordinator-side approval, and its enforcement is platform-owned and not in the supplied evidence.
- The waitlist approval is described as a new account-scoped authorization check on new sandbox or pair setup. Its client and coordinator implementation was not supplied, so whether it fails closed or open on coordinator errors cannot be verified. The notes say it exits 1 when the coordinator is unreachable, and offline 'cluster local' needs no approval. An unverified contract for the next pass: whether the waitlist is an entitlement gate or only an onboarding gate, and whether the threat model should record it if it is a trust boundary.

No findings. needs_deeper_review is false because the supplied change is documentation only; the waitlist code, if it lands in this PR, belongs to other units.
